comparisons.peer_topic: Revolving Credit Facility Terms and Status
comparisons.peer_summary: The Company has $3 billion available under a revolving credit agreement expiring on April 29, 2027, with no outstanding borrowings as of December 28, 2024, and interest rates tied to SOFR or Base Rate plus margins.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel disclose the status and terms of their revolving credit facilities, though the facility structures differ. Intel’s 364-day facility was amended post-period to reduce its limit from $8.0 billion to $5.0 billion with a January 2026 maturity, whereas AMD maintained a $3 billion revolving credit agreement expiring in April 2027 with no outstanding borrowings as of the end of fiscal 2024. Both companies reported zero outstanding balances on these facilities at their respective fiscal year-ends.

sentences.text: In January 2025, we amended our 364-day $8.0 billion credit facility agreement to $5.0 billion, and the maturity date was extended by one year to January 2026.
The Company has $3 billion available under a revolving credit agreement, as amended, that expires on April 29, 2027 (Revolving Credit Agreement).
As of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023, the Company had no outstanding borrowings under the Revolving Credit Agreement.

comparisons.peer_summary: Broadcom entered into a five-year, $7.5 billion unsecured revolving credit agreement in January 2021, which includes a $500 million letter of credit facility and allows borrowing and repayment until January 19, 2026. The company had no outstanding borrowings under this facility at the end of both 2024 and 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Broadcom and Intel both report on the status of their revolving credit facilities, noting zero outstanding borrowings at the end of fiscal 2024. However, Broadcom’s facility is a five-year $7.5 billion unsecured agreement maturing in January 2026, which is larger and structured differently than Intel’s $8.0 billion (post-amendment $5.0 billion) 364-day facility.

sentences.text: In January 2025, we amended our 364-day $8.0 billion credit facility agreement to $5.0 billion, and the maturity date was extended by one year to January 2026.

In January 2021, we entered into a credit agreement (the "2021 Credit Agreement"), which provides for a five-year $7.5 billion unsecured revolving credit facility, of which $500 million is available for the issuance of multi-currency letters of credit.
We had no borrowings outstanding under the revolving credit facility at either November 3, 2024 or October 29, 2023.

comparisons.peer_topic: Revolving Credit Facility Availability and Status
comparisons.peer_summary: As of August 29, 2024, no amounts were outstanding under the Revolving Credit Facility, with $2.50 billion available. The facility matures in May 2026, and borrowed amounts may be prepaid without penalty.
comparisons.comparison: Micron and Intel both disclose that they had no outstanding borrowings on their revolving credit facilities at the end of fiscal 2024. Micron’s facility provided $2.50 billion available and matures in May 2026, while Intel’s 364-day facility had its limit reduced to $5.0 billion and matures in January 2026 following a post-period amendment.

sentences.text: In January 2025, we amended our 364-day $8.0 billion credit facility agreement to $5.0 billion, and the maturity date was extended by one year to January 2026.
As of August 29, 2024, no amounts were outstanding under the Revolving Credit Facility and $2.50 billion was available to us.
